what: motion.interference of the arm turning 0 to 90 in 9 steps into a grounded block
method: Base: box 20x20x10 from (-10,-10,-10), grounded; Arm: box 40x10x10 from (0,-5,0), centre (20,0,5); Stop: box 50x10x10 from (-10,30,0), grounded; the arm's corner (40,5) turned θ reaches y = 40 sin θ + 5 cos θ, which is 30 at θ = asin(30/√1625) - atan(5/40) = 40.9676; samples every 10 degrees: clear at 40, overlapping from step 5 (50) to 9 (90); at 90 the arm (x -5..5, y 0..40) and block (x -10..40, y 30..40) share 10x10x10 = 1000 mm3
